newsitem.title: UK: One Brent date kept, one clocked - trade.
newsitem.headline: One Brent date kept, one clocked - trade.

text.p: One of the Brent cargoes nominated from the paper chains on Monday was kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, while the other was clocked, traders said.
BP kept one of the cargoes loading April 1-3, while the same company was clocked with the other, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
